title: Minimizing 0-currents do not meet the constraint set
statement: Let P be a natural number, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, A ⊆ ℝ^P, and T ∈ 𝒟₀(U) minimizing in A in the sense of Simon 7.1.1 as frozen in the contract (T is integer multiplicity, and M_W(T) ≤ M_W(S) for every open W with W̄ compact ⊆ U and every integer multiplicity S ∈ 𝒟₀(U) such that spt(S − T) is a compact subset of A ∩ W; the condition ∂S = ∂T is vacuous in degree 0). Then spt T ∩ A = ∅.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U 0), IsOpen U → IsMinimizingIn T A → T.support ∩ A = ∅
